purpose: Validate the SCB commuting and worker-age support layer used by labour analysis and industrial scenarios.
validationGate: all five Lulea FA municipalities must be present
commuting workplace series must cover all required years for every workplace municipality
residence-share rows must sum to 100 percent per workplace/year within numerical tolerance
latest commuting matrix must reconcile to workplace totals within numerical tolerance
worker age-group profile must exist for both sexes and the three mutually exclusive age groups 15-24, 25-54 and 55-74 for each workplace municipality
worker age-group shares must sum to 100 percent for each workplace municipality within numerical tolerance
governance: This validates reproducibility and internal accounting of the support data, not a causal migration effect.
Residence shares are commuting/job-residence patterns and must not be interpreted as residential migration probabilities.
The 2024 entrepreneur-classification method break must remain visible in metadata and UI.
